Keywords: House of Warenne Chequy Or Azure
John de Warenne Earl of Surrey
RagShortTexts: The House of Warenne flew the gold-and-blue chequy banner, anchoring royalist defense at Lewes.

Variants.Content: Bearing the gold-and-blue chequy shield dating to the Conquest, the House of Warenne served as Earls of Surrey. Headquartered at Lewes Castle, John de Warenne married Henry III's half-sister, standing as the fiercest royalist opponent against Montfort's reform councils, claiming his lands were held by the right of the sword.
Arrogant and steadfast, Warenne mobilized seasoned retinues in Sussex, maintaining open communications across the English Channel for royal reinforcements.
The blue-and-gold chequered pennant commands respect across Sussex downlands. Warenne patrols brook no anti-royalist sedition in village taverns.
